dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Here's a fun one. Will cars fly by 2050?
dialogue.reading: hɪrz ə ˈfʌn ˈwʌn. wɪl ˈkɑːrz ˈflaɪ baɪ ˈtwɛnti ˈfɪfti?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I doubt that cars will fly. It's too dangerous.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdaʊt ðæt ˈkɑːrz wɪl ˈflaɪ. ɪts ˈtuː ˈdeɪndʒərəs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Very unlikely. But I'm sure that robots will do our housework.
dialogue.reading: ˈvɛri ʌnˈlaɪkli. bʌt aɪm ˈʃʊr ðæt ˈroʊbɑːts wɪl ˈduː aʊər ˈhaʊswɜːrk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No way! I'm sure students will still need real teachers like you.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈweɪ! aɪm ˈʃʊr ˈstuːdənts wɪl ˈstɪl ˈniːd ˈriːəl ˈtiːtʃərz laɪk ˈjuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Thank you, Nam. And will Thailand win the World Cup by 2050?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː, ˈnɑːm. ənd wɪl ˈtaɪlænd ˈwɪn ðə ˈwɜːrld ˈkʌp baɪ ˈtwɛnti ˈfɪfti?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Hmm, I'm doubtful about that. But who knows?
dialogue.reading: ˈhm, aɪm ˈdaʊtfəl əˈbaʊt ˈðæt. bʌt ˈhuː ˈnoʊz?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Well, I bet Bangkok will host the Asian Games again.
dialogue.reading: ˈwɛl, aɪ ˈbɛt ˈbæŋkɑːk wɪl ˈhoʊst ði ˈeɪʒən ˈɡeɪmz əˈɡɛn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I bet it will, too. Bangkok has hosted them four times already.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈbɛt ɪt ˈwɪl, ˈtuː. ˈbæŋkɑːk hæz ˈhoʊstɪd ðɛm ˈfɔːr ˈtaɪmz ɔːlˈrɛdi.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Last question: will people still be learning English in 2050?
dialogue.reading: ˈlæst ˈkwɛstʃən: wɪl ˈpiːpəl ˈstɪl bi ˈlɜːrnɪŋ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪn ˈtwɛnti ˈfɪfti?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'm sure they will. Maybe AI will translate everything, but I doubt that people will stop learning languages.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈʃʊr ðeɪ ˈwɪl. ˈmeɪbi ˌeɪˈaɪ wɪl trænsˈleɪt ˈɛvriθɪŋ, bʌt aɪ ˈdaʊt ðæt ˈpiːpəl wɪl ˈstɑːp ˈlɜːrnɪŋ ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒɪz.
